protocol: lending pool with spot-price AMM oracle
real_flaw: lending pool prices collateral from manipulable AMM spot reserves (no TWAP / no conservation check)
flag_gate: attacker asset balance >= attacker_endowment + min_profit, reachable only by swapping to inflate the collateral spot price then over-borrowing at the manipulated price

contracts.AssetToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 (stock, fixed-supply mint in constructor) - the borrow asset
contracts.CollateralToken: OpenZeppelin ERC20 v5.1.0 (stock, fixed-supply mint in constructor) - the collateral
contracts.SimpleAMM: Uniswap-V2-style constant-product pair (0.3% fee); getSpotPrice() = reserveAsset/reserveCollateral from current reserves (manipulable)
contracts.LendingPool: naive: prices collateral via SimpleAMM.getSpotPrice() (the manipulable spot oracle), borrow bounded by collateral*LTV (vulnerable)
contracts.LendingPoolSafe: fixed: maxBorrow rejects spot prices outside a deviation band of the reference price (the documented mitigation; negative test)
contracts.FlagVault: claim(taskId,flag) gated on attacker asset balance >= profitThreshold AND keccak256(flag) == expectedHash
